We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Expansion Manager to focus on market expansion and build and scale Distribusion’s airport transfer operator network across Europe. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build a business within a company. Working within Distribusion’s broader airport commercial strategy, you will own a clearly defined sub-segment end to end - from identifying attractive markets and securing operator partnerships to launching them and delivering measurable commercial growth.
You will have the opportunity to build the approach from scratch, deliver highly visible results and take on broader responsibility as the segment scales.


What you will do

  • Translate the broader airport strategy into a prioritised expansion plan, based on market potential, coverage gaps and clear business cases

  • Build a repeatable market-entry playbook, incorporating market feedback and lessons from execution

  • Originate, negotiate and close partnerships with airport transfer operators, supported by compelling and tailored commercial propositions

  • Build senior relationships with operators, airports, airport authorities and relevant local partners to unlock market access and growth

  • Coordinate internal teams through contracting, integration, launch and ramp-up

  • Own post-launch commercial performance, identify gaps and drive corrective actions

Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid or Europe & Remote


Who you are:

  • You bring 2-3 years at a top-tier consulting firm, or 3-5 years in sales, business development, or a commercial role at a high-growth tech company.

  • You have a track record of taking ownership of a commercial area and growing it: markets deepened, strategies sharpened, results delivered

  • You can navigate product complexity and translate it into a compelling sales narrative; experience as a tech BD or sales engineer with full commercial cycle ownership is a strong signal

  • Experience in a tech company, marketplace, or platform business is a strong advantage; B2B sales experience is a plus

  • A background in consulting, or experience at a high-growth tech platform or fast-scaling startup, tells us a lot about your operating style

  • You are self-driven, independent, and resourceful; you thrive with full ownership and minimal guidance

  • You collaborate well in a matrixed environment and bring positive ambition to teams where others are also running their own markets

  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills

  • You are fluent in English (spoken and written); an additional European language, French, German, or others, is a big plus

What you can expect:

  • Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

  • Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

  • Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

  • Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com, Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

  • Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.

title: Head of Public Affairs (Germany & EU) @ AI Infrastructure Venture, Dresden
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

We're building next-generation HPC and AI infrastructure for a world where brute-force compute is reaching its limits. Our chip and system architecture is designed to exploit sparsity at scale, focusing compute where it matters most and eliminating unnecessary computation everywhere else. That means orders-of-magnitude gains in performance and efficiency. We're based in Dresden and working at the intersection of deep tech, European industrial policy, and the global AI race.

About the Role

This is a senior hire at the centre of how we engage with government, regulators, and the broader European policy landscape. You'll lead our public affairs strategy across Germany and the EU, shaping how we're positioned in some of the most consequential policy debates of the decade: AI, semiconductors, digital sovereignty, and high-performance computing. You'll work directly with the CEO and leadership team, with real ownership over how we show up in Berlin and Brussels.

What you'll do

  • Define and execute our public affairs strategy across German federal and regional government, and EU institutions in Brussels

  • Monitor and anticipate regulatory, legislative, and geopolitical developments that affect our business

  • Build and maintain relationships with policymakers, institutional partners, and government stakeholders

  • Represent us in high-level meetings, consultations, and policy forums in Berlin and Brussels

  • Position us as a recognised voice in European AI infrastructure and deep tech

  • Engage with industry alliances, think tanks, and research institutions across Germany and the EU

  • Identify and support access to public funding programmes, including Horizon Europe, the Chips Act, IPCEI, and national innovation programmes

  • Drive participation in strategic consortia and collaborative European initiatives

  • Develop policy narratives around AI, compute infrastructure, and European competitiveness

  • Contribute to position papers, consultation responses, and public communications

  • Support CEO and leadership visibility in policy and industry discussions

  • Advise internally on regulatory risks and opportunities, helping align corporate strategy with the political landscape

About You

You understand how policy gets made in Berlin and Brussels, and you know how to get a deep tech company into the right rooms. You're equally comfortable briefing a minister, drafting a position paper, or working with an engineering team to translate what we do into language that resonates with policymakers. You think strategically but you're hands-on, and you're motivated by the idea of shaping European technology policy from inside a company that's building something genuinely new.

  • Significant experience in public affairs, government relations, or policy, with a strong track record across both Germany and EU institutions

  • Background in deep tech, AI, semiconductors, or advanced computing

  • An established network in Berlin and / or Brussels policy circles

  • Experience working within or alongside startups or scale-ups, not just large corporates

  • Able to translate complex technical topics into clear, accessible messaging for non-technical audiences

  • Professional fluency in both English and German

Nice to have:

  • Additional EU languages

  • Experience with IPCEI processes or large-scale European consortium programmes

  • Familiarity with German federal and regional funding landscapes

Why Join

We're at an inflection point. The European policy environment around AI, semiconductors, and compute infrastructure is moving fast, and we're right in the middle of it. This role gives you direct influence over how a deep tech company engages with some of the most important policy debates in Europe today. You'll work closely with the CEO, have genuine ownership of the strategy, and help shape how Europe builds its compute future. We offer relocation support and a flexible, inclusive working environment.

title: Founder Associate (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI is being built into more products every month, and every interaction consumes tokens. As usage grows, the costs add up quickly. The first race was adoption. The next one is efficiency, because inference costs increasingly decide what companies can afford to build and ship. We are building the efficiency layer for production AI. Our systems make AI dramatically leaner, cutting token usage and lowering the cost of every interaction without giving up the quality standards that matter. We work with enterprise software companies, and we want to become a core part of the global AI ecosystem.

About the Role

You will work directly with our founder and CEO on whatever matters most that week. A lot of it is commercial: working out who needs us, getting into conversations with them, understanding what they run and what it costs them. The rest is everything else that needs doing when a company is this young. We closed our pre-seed in 3 weeks and are now preparing our first customer pilots, so there is a lot of ground to cover and very few people to cover it. This is a rare seat for someone early in their career / you will see how a company gets built and you will build a good part of it yourself.

What you'll do

  • Work alongside the founder on the priorities that matter most, which will change as we grow.

  • Research the market and help us work out who our best customers are and why.

  • Build target lists, write outreach and get conversations started with technology and software companies in DACH.

  • Join customer conversations, take notes that matter and turn what you hear into sharper positioning.

  • Learn how customers run their AI workloads, what those workloads cost and the quality standards they need.

  • Set up the tools, CRM and processes we need to keep track of customers as the volume grows.

  • Use AI throughout your own work so a team of our size can cover far more ground.

  • Prepare materials for customers, investors and partners.

  • Pick up the unglamorous groundwork nobody else has got to yet.

About You

We are looking for someone early in their career who learns quickly and takes on more than the title suggests. You will not have done most of this before, and that is fine. What matters is that you are curious about customers, comfortable without much structure, and inclined to work out the answer yourself before asking for it.

  • You have spent some time in a startup, a venture fund, consulting or a commercial role, whether through a job, an internship or something you built yourself.

  • You enjoy talking to people you have not met before and can hold your own with commercial and technical audiences alike.

  • You write clearly and can turn messy input into something structured.

  • You are comfortable with software and already use AI tools well in your own work.

  • You are interested in AI infrastructure, developer tools or enterprise software, and can pick up a technical product quickly.

  • You create structure from ambiguity and stay practical about what it takes to get results.

  • Fluent English is required. Fluent German is a strong advantage.

Why Join

You will join at the earliest stage, work next to the founder every day and watch decisions get made rather than hear about them later. The role is broad on purpose, so what you own will grow as fast as you do, with a clear path into a commercial or operating role as the team grows. The pace is high and the timelines are ambitious, and that asks a lot of everyone here. It suits someone who wants real responsibility early and is motivated by building something at speed.

This is a full-time role based in our Berlin office 5 days a week, with a start date as soon as possible.

title: SAP Procurement & Supply Chain Transformation Consultant - Life Sciences Germany
description:
SAP Procurement & Supply Chain Transformation Consultant – Life Sciences

 

Are you ready to help Life Sciences organizations build resilient, compliant, and intelligent procurement functions that enable innovation, accelerate growth, and strengthen supply security?

 

About your role

Infosys Consulting is seeking talented and highly motivated consultants to join our Life Sciences practice specializing in Procurement and Supply Chain Transformation.

As a SAP Procurement & Supply Chain Transformation Consultant, you will help pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations transform procurement operating models, optimize supplier networks, and modernize Source-to-Pay processes through a combination of business consulting and digital technologies.

You will work with procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, and IT stakeholders to improve operational efficiency, supplier performance, compliance, and business resilience. Combining business process expertise with SAP-enabled transformation capabilities, you will support clients across strategy, design, implementation, and value realization initiatives.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES                                                                                                                        

Procurement Strategy and Transformation

  • Assess procurement operating models and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, compliance, supplier collaboration, and business value.
  • Support procurement transformation initiatives across direct, indirect, and R&D-related spend categories.
  • Design future-state procurement processes, governance models, and organizational capabilities.
  • Develop business cases and transformation roadmaps aligned with client objectives.

Source-to-Pay Process Excellence

  • Analyze and optimize Source-to-Contract, Procure-to-Pay, Supplier Management, and Category Management processes.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, analytics, AI, and digital procurement capabilities.
  • Drive working capital, supplier performance, and procurement productivity improvements.

SAP and Digital Procurement Transformation

  • Support implementation and optimization of SAP procurement solutions, including SAP S/4HANA Procurement and SAP Ariba.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable process and technology designs.
  • Assist clients in designing integrated procurement processes across ERP, supplier, quality, and supply chain systems.

Life Sciences Supplier and Compliance Management

  • Support initiatives involving contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs), and strategic suppliers.
  • Collaborate with Quality and Supply Chain functions to strengthen risk management and supply continuity.

Thought Leadership and Enablement

  • Monitor trends across procurement transformation, supplier ecosystems, sustainability, AI, and supply chain resilience.
  • Develop reusable methodologies, assets, and industry perspectives.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to capability development within the Life Sciences practice.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS                                                                            

Demonstrates proven success in roles and thorough abilities in most of the following areas:

·       Strong understanding of procurement and supply chain processes within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated industries.

·       Experience across Source-to-Pay, Supplier Management, Strategic Sourcing, Category Management, or Procurement Operations.

·       Familiarity with SAP procurement capabilities, including SAP MM, SAP S/4HANA Procurement, SAP Ariba, or related solutions.

·       Experience translating business requirements into process and technology transformation initiatives.

·       Understanding of procurement data, analytics, supplier performance management, and procurement governance.

·       Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.

·       Experience supporting business transformation and technology-enabled change programs.

·       7+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience.

·       Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Life Sciences, Information Technology, or related field.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS                                                                            

·       Experience within pharmaceutical or biotechnology procurement organizations.

·       Knowledge of direct materials procurement, external manufacturing, clinical supply procurement, or supplier quality management.

·       Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, SAP Business Network, SAP IBP, or SAP BTP.

·       Familiarity with CMO/CDMO operating models and supplier collaboration processes.

·       Experience identifying and implementing AI, GenAI, or Agentic AI use cases across Source-to-Pay and Supplier Management processes.

·       Experience assessing supplier risk, business continuity, and procurement resilience strategies

·       Understanding of ESG and sustainable procurement practices.

·       Experience of working in global delivery environments.

·       MBA, MSc, CIPS, APICS, or equivalent professional qualifications.

·       Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Standard closing  (by HR)

Given that this is only a snapshot of the role, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all of the requirements listed above. We are looking for team members who strive to make an impact, challenge conventional thinking, and help shape the future of Life Sciences R&D. If this sounds like you and you feel you have the skills and experience required, then please apply now.

About your team

Join our growing Life Sciences practice and make a difference.

In this practice you will have a passion for unlocking the most innovative technological solutions used to improve the world of life sciences.  In this role you’ll be able to see your own ideas transform into breakthrough results for some of the largest pharma companies around the world.  This is more than just a job, it’s an opportunity to make a real difference.[AS1] 

About Infosys Consulting

Be part of a globally renowned management consulting firm on the front-line of industry disruption and at the cutting edge of technology.  We work with market leading brands across sectors. Our culture is inclusive and entrepreneurial. Being a mid-size consultancy within the scale of Infosys gives us the global reach to partner with our clients throughout their transformation journey.

Wonach suchen wir?

title: Senior/Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion. Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh, and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and New York.

We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective.

About the Role

We are seeking a Foundational Machine Learning Engineer for a high-impact greenfield opportunity to build our MLOps infrastructure from the ground up at Vestiaire Collective. While driving our AI authentication initiatives (deploying multi-model approaches including computer vision for luxury product authentication and counterfeit detection) will be your immediate focus, your long-term mission will be to scale foundational architecture across the entire marketplace. You will expand our ML capabilities to power broader domains, primarily focusing on search and recommendation systems, with future expansions into dynamic pricing and marketing technologies. Acting as the bridge among Applied Science, Data Platform, and Backend Engineering, you will design robust, decoupled architectures and spearhead the MLOps strategy with our Director of Data, prioritizing system maintainability, engineering hygiene, and the reliable deployment of complex models, ensuring all our ML models across the board deliver high-throughput, low-latency business impact.

What You Will Do

  • Short-Term Impact (First 6 Months): Partner closely with the Operations squads and Data Scientists to accelerate ML and RAG prototypes into resilient, production-ready code. You will directly integrate with the team to deploy, optimize, and scale heavy-width CV and VLM models focused on fraud detection and luxury product authentication, immediately improving our trust and safety ecosystem.

  • Mid-Term Foundation (MLOps Lifecycle & Infrastructure): Lead the end-to-end foundational groundwork of our ML lifecycle by designing robust systems for Data & Feature Management, Model Tracking & Registry, and Model Serving & Monitoring. You will scale infrastructure by automating continuous retraining pipelines that handle diverse deployment cadences (from daily fraud detection to weekly recommendations), design resilient multi-model architectures, and critically evaluate the technical overhead and TCO of our in-house tools against enterprise-grade platforms to ensure long-term resilience.

Ein kleines Stück Papier mit Zahlen, die das Potenzial haben, ein Leben für immer zu verändern! Ok…ersetzten wir das Papier durch eine App und eine Person gegen 600.000+ Nutzer monatlich. This is our Business!

📌 Deine Mission

Als Senior CRM / Lifecycle Manager (m/w/d) treibst Du das Herzstück unserer Wachstumsstrategie voran: Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche End-to-End-Verantwortung für die Player Journey nach der Akquisition und transformierst App-Installationen und Erstspieler in begeisterte, loyale und wertvolle Nutzer. Dein klares Ziel: Die Retention-Kurve und den Player Lifetime Value auf ein neues Level zu heben, Churn konsequent zu minimieren und jeden in das Marketing investierten Euro durch eine meisterhafte Bindungsstrategie maximal zu hebeln.

Auf den Punkt gebrach -> Du baust das fundamentale Lifecycle-Programm von Grund auf auf, schützt den Wert unserer expandierenden Nutzerbasis und machst sie nachhaltig zu unserem größten Wachstumsmotor!

Aufgaben

  • Operative Steuerung und Optimierung der täglichen Lifecycle-Kampagnen über Push-Benachrichtigungen, E-Mail und In-App-Messaging in CleverTap.
  • Konzeption, Umsetzung und Betreuung automatisierter Journeys entlang der Phasen Onboarding, Aktivierung, Retention, Winback und Monetarisierung.
  • Entwicklung verhaltens- und lifecycle-basierter Segmentierungs- und Targeting-Logiken zur Sicherstellung der optimalen Botschaft zum richtigen Zeitpunkt.
  • Systematische Durchführung von A/B-Tests hinsichtlich Messaging, Timing, Kanal und Angeboten (Offers) inklusive fortlaufender Dokumentation der Learnings.
  • Analyse von Retention-Kurven, Kohorten, Engagement, Churn sowie des LTVs und Aufbau passender Dashboards in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Data-Team.
  • Strategische Steuerung der Post-Acquisition Player Journey und ganzheitliche Verantwortung für den gesamten Lifecycle-Funnel.
  • Enge Abstimmung und Koordination gemeinsamer Initiativen mit den Teams aus Marketing, User Acquisition, Social Media, Data und Product.
  • Sicherstellung aller relevanten Compliance-Anforderungen (insb. GlüStV) sowie Berücksichtigung von Responsible-Gaming-Prinzipien und spezifischen Kommunikationsrichtlinien im Lotterieumfeld.

Qualifikation

Must-have:

  • Tiefgehende, praktische Erfahrung mit Marketing-Automation-Plattformen (z. B. CleverTap, Braze, Leanplum, Iterable, MoEngage) inklusive der eigenständigen technischen Umsetzung von Kampagnen.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der kanalübergreifenden Mobile-Kommunikation via Push-Notifications, E-Mail und In-App-Messaging.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in verhaltensbasierter Segmentierung sowie in der End-to-End-Entwicklung und dem Rollout mehrstufiger, automatisierter Customer Journeys.
  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Auswertung und iterativen Optimierung von A/B-Tests und Experimenten.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Product-Analytics-Tools (z. B. Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), im Aufbau von Dashboards sowie in der Analyse von Tabellenmodellen, Retention-Kurven und Kohorten.
  • Ausgeprägtes Verständnis relevanter Mobile-Lifecycle-KPIs wie Churn, LTV, DAU/MAU und Retention-Raten.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse für die tägliche Arbeit im Team.

Softskills:

  • Ownership mindset — Eigenverantwortliches Handeln.
  • Data-driven & experiment-oriented — Datengesteuerte und agile Arbeitsweise.
  • Player-empathy / customer-centric — Starke Kundenorientierung & Empathie.
  • Collaborative — Teamfähigkeit.
  • Detail-oriented — Hohe Detailgenauigkeit.
  • Comfortable with startup ambiguity — Sicherheit im Umgang mit Dynamik.
  • Responsible-gaming mindset — Verantwortungsbewusstsein (Responsible Gaming).

Dein Background:

  • 3–5 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung im CRM-, Lifecycle- oder Retention-Marketing.
  • Ein starker Hintergrund im Bereich B2C Consumer Apps (Mobile-First, Install-getriebenes Geschäftsmodell) wird ausdrücklich bevorzugt.
  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium oder eine vergleichbare, in der Praxis erworbene Qualifikation.
  • Idealerweise erste Erfahrung in stark regulierten Branchen wie dem Lotteriewesen, Fintech oder Glücksspiel (iGaming).
  • Erfahrung beim Aufbau einer Lifecycle-Marketing-Struktur aus einer frühen oder sehr schlanken (Lean) Ausgangslage heraus.

Benefits

🎁 Was wir dir bieten:

Vergütung & Work-Life-Balance:

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.
  • 30 Urlaubstage im Jahr
  • 2 zusätzliche Feiertage (24.12, 31.12)
  • Großzügiges Weiterbildungsbudget
  • Ausgefallene Teamevents
  • Innovatives Benefit-Programm

Kommunikation & Vertrauen:

  • Eine offene, ehrliche und direkte Kommunikation. Deine Ideen sind willkommen!
  • Ein Feedbackgespräch jedes Quartals, um gemeinsam zu wachsen.

Modernes Arbeiten:

  • Alles, was du für deinen Arbeitsalltag brauchst: MacBook, Kopfhörer, u.v.m.
  • Ein modernes und inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld in Berlin oder in Konstanz am Bodensee.

Individuelle Weiterbildung:

  • Ein Weiterbildungs-Tag pro Monat und ein großzügiges Weiterbildungsbudget für deine persönliche Entwicklung.

Buddy-Programm:

  • Ein erfahrener Teamkollege begleitet dich von Anfang an, um dir bei deinem Einstieg zu helfen.

Das Team

  • Wir sind ein bunt gemixter Haufen aus unterschiedlichen Nationen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen. Wir unterscheiden nicht nach Religion, Geschlecht, Alter, Familienstand… . Für uns steht im Mittelpunkt was du kannst!

🪴Unsere Werte:

MAKE IT HAPPEN 💪🏼

  • Ergebnisse erzielen – Übernimm Verantwortung für Problem, Ziel und Ergebnis durch Selbstorganisation und datenbasierte Entscheidungen.
  • Mutig sprechen – Fordere Ideen heraus und nenne Probleme direkt, wenn es drauf ankommt.
  • Dinge erledigen – Sei pragmatisch, halte den Schwung und bringe Energie rein.
  • Wertvolle Wirkung erzeugen – Stelle Lösungen bereit, die unsere Mission und strategischen Ziele vorantreiben.

WIN TOGETHER 💚

  • Offen und respektvoll kommunizieren – Sei transparent, gehe von guten Absichten aus und stelle dein Ego zurück, wenn du mit anderen interagierst.
  • Anderen zum Erfolg verhelfen – Teile proaktiv Wissen, Zeit und Stärken in interdisziplinären Teams.
  • Über Kulturen hinweg arbeiten – Lerne aus diversen Perspektiven und passe deinen Stil aktiv an, um vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit in diversen Teams zu ermöglichen.
  • Teamgeist wecken – Schaffe Momente der Freude und Verbundenheit, die zu großen Erfolgen führen.

SHAPE THE FUTURE 🚀

  • Experimentieren, um zu lernen – Führe Tests durch, messe Ergebnisse, behandle Fehler als Lernchance und setze Erkenntnisse um.
  • Chancen erkennen – Bleib nah am Kunden und Markttrends, um das Nächste zu identifizieren.
  • Nutzerzentrierte Innovation bauen – Nutze zuverlässige, datenbasierte Lösungen und Services, die den Maßstab setzen.
  • Dich selbst weiterentwickeln – Hinterfrage deine Arbeitsweise, hole Feedback ein und baue deine Fähigkeiten aus.

title: Social-Media Werkstudentin (m/w/d) für Mainwebsolutions & Closery, Würzburg vor Ort
description:
Du hast richtig Lust, Social-Media-Accounts eigenständig zu übernehmen und wachsen zu lassen? Du stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera, drehst Reels, hast Ideen im Kopf, bevor jemand danach fragt, und begeisterst dich für KI- und Digitalthemen? Dann suchen wir genau dich: Als Werkstudentin (m/w/d) übernimmst du bei uns die Social-Media-Betreuung von zwei Marken, Mainwebsolutions und Closery, und baust gemeinsam mit den Gründern ein eigenes Podcast-Format auf. Bewirb dich jetzt auf eine Werkstudierendenstelle mit echter Verantwortung.

Was erwartet dich bei uns?

Willkommen bei Mainwebsolutions, der Agentur, die Softwareentwicklung und Onlinemarketing auf ein neues Level hebt! Unser Team besteht aus talentierten Marketern und Entwicklern, die gemeinsam durchstarten. Mit Closery, unserer Voice-AI-Plattform für Shopify und E-Commerce, bauen wir zudem ein eigenes SaaS-Produkt auf, das du auf Social Media von Tag eins an mitprägst. Jeder Tag beginnt mit einer ordentlichen Portion Humor und einem morgendlichen Meeting, in dem wir einander über aktuelle Themen und Fortschritte informieren. Anschließend tauchen wir in die Projekte ein und arbeiten gemeinsam daran, den Erfolg unserer Kunden und unserer eigenen Produkte weiter zu steigern. Doch bei uns geht es nicht nur um Arbeit! Wir feiern unsere Erfolge regelmäßig mit coolen Teamevents. Von Grillpartys auf der Dachterrasse bis zu geselligen Weinfesten, jeder kann sich an unseren Aktivitäten beteiligen. Eines ist sicher: Bei uns steht das Team an erster Stelle. Erlebe den Spirit von Mainwebsolutions! #workatmws

Dein Aufgabenbereich?

Du übernimmst die Social-Media-Accounts von Mainwebsolutions und Closery autark, also von der Idee über die Umsetzung bis zur Analyse. Du entwickelst eigenständig Content-Ideen und Formate, planst deine Beiträge selbst und sorgst dafür, dass beide Accounts auf Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok und Co. sichtbar wachsen. Dabei stehst du selbst vor der Kamera: Du drehst Reels, sprichst in kurzen Videos über KI-, Digital- und E-Commerce-Themen und gibst unseren Marken ein Gesicht. Gemeinsam mit den Geschäftsführern beider Brands baust du ein kleines Podcast-Format auf, begleitest die Aufnahmen, schneidest die Folgen und verwertest sie als Clips für Social Media. Du beobachtest Trends, testest neue Formate und leitest aus den Zahlen ab, was funktioniert und was nicht. Vorgaben brauchst du dafür keine, du bringst die Ideen mit und setzt sie um.



Das bringst du mit:

  • Lust auf eigene Accounts: Du willst nicht nur zuarbeiten, sondern Social-Media-Kanäle eigenverantwortlich führen und sichtbar wachsen lassen.

  • Keine Kamerascheu: Du stehst gerne selbst vor der Kamera, drehst Reels, sprichst frei in Videos und hast Lust, in einem Podcast-Format mit unseren Geschäftsführern mitzuwirken.

  • Begeisterung für KI- und Digitalthemen: Künstliche Intelligenz, Automatisierung, E-Commerce und Onlinemarketing interessieren dich wirklich, und du kannst diese Themen verständlich und unterhaltsam erzählen.

  • Selbstständigkeit und Eigeninitiative: Du generierst eigene Ideen, planst deinen Content selbst und brauchst keine Vorgaben, um loszulegen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Social-Media-Plattformen: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn und Co. sind dir vertraut, und du verstehst, welche Inhalte dort funktionieren.

  • Grundkenntnisse im Videoschnitt: Du musst kein Video-Profi sein, aber du kannst ein Reel oder eine Podcast-Folge mit Tools wie CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci Resolve oder vergleichbarer Software schneiden oder hast Lust, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Trendgespür und Teamgeist: Du erkennst Trends früh, bist offen für Feedback und hast Spaß daran, in einem dynamischen Team etwas aufzubauen.


Das bieten wir:

  • Sicherer und langfristiger Arbeitsplatz: Wir legen großen Wert auf eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit. Unser Ziel ist es, jede Person, die wir einstellen, individuell zu fördern und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zu bieten, damit du gemeinsam mit uns wachsen kannst.

  • Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Unser gemeinsames Ziel ist sowohl die persönliche Weiterentwicklung als auch das Erreichen unserer Firmenziele. Hierfür ziehen wir alle an einem Strang!

  • Team Family: Flache Hierarchien, eine offene Feedbackkultur und regelmäßige gemeinsame Teamevents, die du nicht verpassen solltest. Wenn du Full-Remote für uns arbeitest und an einem Teamevent teilnehmen möchtest, übernehmen wir selbstverständlich Transfer- und Hotelkosten für dich.

  • Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten: In kaum einer Branche ist die Weiterentwicklung der Mitarbeiter so wichtig, wie in der Digitalbranche. Neben der Möglichkeit der Absolvierung verschiedener Zertifizierungen nehmen wir sowohl an Online- als auch an Offline-Events mit unserem Team teil. Hierfür steht dir jährlich 1.500€ Weiterentwicklungsbudget zur Verfügung.

  • Persönliche Entwicklung und Wachstum: Wir unterstützen dich aktiv dabei, deine beruflichen Ziele zu erreichen und dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Leistungen werden anerkannt, und es bestehen Möglichkeiten für Beförderungen im Rahmen deiner Entwicklung.

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (BAV): Wir bieten dir eine attraktive betriebliche Altersvorsorge, bei der wir als Arbeitgeber bis zu 100% auf deinen Sparbeitrag obendrauf legen. D.h. du erhältst bei uns zusätzlich bis zu 2400€ netto pro Jahr.

  • Gutschein als steuerfreier Sachbezug: Um dir im Alltag noch eine kleine Freude zu machen, bekommst du jeden Monat einen 50€ Gutschein deiner Wahl. Hier arbeiten wir mit der Plattform Belonio zusammen. Dadurch erhältst du noch einmal einen finanziellen Vorteil von 600€ im Jahr, zusätzlich zu deinem regulären Gehalt.

  • EGYM Wellpass als steuerfreier Sachbezug: Anstatt einem Gutschein lieber in die Gesundheit investieren? EGYM Wellpass ist ein Netzwerk aus über 8.000 Sport- und Wellnesseinrichtungen in ganz Deutschland und Österreich. Dazu zählen Fitness- und Yogastudios, Schwimmbäder, Kletter- und Boulderhallen sowie Functional Training Einrichtungen. Mithilfe des EGYM Wellpasses kannst du in allen Partnerstudios unbegrenzt und flexibel trainieren. Eine Übersicht aller nutzbaren Einrichtungen und inkludierten Leistungen findest du auf der Homepage (https://egym-wellpass.com/) in der Studiosuche oder in der Wellpass App.

  • Dienstrad-Leasing: Mit unserem Dienstrad-Leasing-Programm kannst du ganz einfach ein hochwertiges Fahrrad oder E-Bike über uns leasen und damit nicht nur umweltfreundlich unterwegs sein, sondern auch deiner Gesundheit etwas Gutes tun. Die Abwicklung erfolgt unkompliziert über unseren Leasingpartner, und du profitierst von attraktiven steuerlichen Vorteilen.

  • Individuelles Arbeits-Setup: Wir bieten dir modernste Ausstattung und die Möglichkeit, dein komplettes Setup nach deinen Bedürfnissen zu gestalten – von der Wahl der Geräte bis zum bevorzugten Betriebssystem (Windows, Mac oder Linux), damit du optimal arbeiten kannst.

  • Claude Max für jeden Mitarbeiter: Wir stellen jedem im Team einen Claude Max Plan bereit. So arbeitest du täglich mit dem aktuell leistungsstärksten KI-Modell und hast Zugriff auf alle Claude Skills, die wir intern entwickeln.

  • Einen ortsunabhängigen Job: Arbeite mit uns im Büro, aus dem Homeoffice oder Full-Remote. Du möchtest mal ein paar Wochen aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten? Auch das ist kein Problem bei der Mainwebsolutions.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Entscheide selbst, wann du morgens startest. Natürlich haben wir tagsüber auch Termine, aber eine gewisse Flexibilität in den Arbeitszeiten, lässt dich deinen persönlichen Alltag besser gestalten.

  • Attraktive und faire Vergütung: Wir bieten dir ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, das sich an deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation orientiert. Regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche ermöglichen uns, deine Entwicklung zu reflektieren und eröffnen dir die Option zur Gehaltssteigerung entsprechend deinen Fortschritten und Leistungen.

  • Kostenlose Büro-Goodies: Rückengesundheit, Office-Days und regelmäßige Team-Mittagsessen.

  • Moderne Büroräume in der Würzburger Innenstadt

We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world—moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can’t solve. We are on a mission to redefine how physical work gets done, and we’re looking for curious, bold thinkers to help shape the future of robotics with us.

Overview:

We are looking for a hands-on electrician or automation technician to support the build, installation, and optimization of our robotic systems. You will be responsible for wiring, testing, and commissioning electrical components both in our lab and on-site. You will collaborate closely with mechanical and software teams to ensure seamless system integration, resolve technical issues, and implement improvements across new and existing systems.

Your Responsibilities:

Installation & Integration

  • Build and wire electrical systems for robotic applications, including cabinets and field wiring. 

  • Support system commissioning in the robotics lab and at customer locations.  

  • Work closely with mechanical and software engineers to ensure correct system integration.  

  • Implement technical improvements and modifications based on project feedback.  

  • Diagnose and resolve electrical faults during development and deployment.

Qualifications:

Education and Experience

  • Completed technical training (e.g. State-certified Technician in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or Automation) or a comparable vocational qualification (e.g. Electrician, Control Cabinet Builder, Electrical Master)

  • Certified to perform electrical work (Elektrofachkraft – EFK)

  • Relevant professional experience in automation or robotics preferred

  • Willingness to travel: ≈ 25-50%

Skills

  • Experience with electrical installations, control systems, sensors, and actuators  

  • Hands-on mentality and technical craftsmanship

  • Basic knowledge of EPLAN/Splan is a plus

  • Valid Class B driver’s license (EU)

Our interview plan:

  • Application

  • Take‑home assignment: You’ll work on a short, role‑relevant task with clear instructions and a deadline.

  • Cultural fit interview (40 min): A conversation about how you work, what motivates you, and what you’re looking for. Expect CV highlights, your “why,” and time for your questions.

  • Technical fit interview (45 min): A deeper dive into your skills and problem‑solving approach for this role.

  • On‑site visit: Meet the team in our office and collaborate on a real challenge similar to the work you’d do here. You’ll also meet a founder; we aim to give you a clear feel for the role and environment.

What We Offer:

  • Wellpass (gym membership)  

  • Flexible working hours  

  • Option to work from home when needed  

  • A motivated team and an open corporate culture  

  • Competitive compensation and excellent career development opportunities

description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

Where 50 Billion Daily Predictions Begin

The User Experience team is the origin point of adjoe Ads. Everything the system knows about a user, every prediction the ML models make, every bid placed in an auction. It all starts with code this team ships.

The team owns two responsibilities. On the SDK side, a native Kotlin and Swift code runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. It participates in 120 million daily auctions, renders ad creatives across multiple formats, and captures the behavioral signals that power 50 billion predictions per day. The constraint that defines this work: you're executing inside someone else's app, on someone else's device, with zero tolerance for instability. Every ad impression has to feel native and fast to the user.

On the analytics side, the dashboards, investigation tools, and data frameworks that turn raw data into decisions: real-time revenue performance across active campaigns, infrastructure cost visibility, and data quality assessments. If a number matters to the business or to engineering, this team makes it accessible.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • Kotlin & Android Internals Expertise: You will own the core development and optimization of the adjoe Ads SDK, which runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. We are looking for someone with 8+ years of Android experience (or 3+ years specifically in SDK/library development) who works primarily with Kotlin and has a deep understanding of Android lifecycles, ProGuard/R8, and multithreading to ensure zero tolerance for instability on millions of devices.

  • High-Performance Network Design: You will collaborate with backend teams to design APIs and capture behavioral signals that power 50 billion daily ML predictions. You need a strong track record in API design, maintaining strict backward compatibility for thousands of external integrators, and working with high-performance networking protocols like gRPC, Protobuf, Wire, and OkHTTP.

  • Resource-Constrained Optimization: You will ensure every ad impression feels native and fast while participating in 120 million daily auctions. You must know how to design for minimal footprint, optimizing battery impact and memory usage, as your code executes directly inside someone else’s app and device.

  • Data-Driven Observability: You will monitor, debug, and maintain SDK reliability at scale across millions of global users. You will leverage observability and data tools—including Sentry, Kibana, and AWS (S3, QuickSight, Athena)—to track errors, investigate SDK behavior, and turn raw data into clear engineering decisions.

  • Build Automation & Delivery: You will maintain and improve our CI/CD pipelines to guarantee efficient, reliable SDK delivery. This requires hands-on experience with Gradle and GitLab CI to automate the testing, building, and packaging of our mobile libraries.

  • Plus – AdTech & Low-Level Systems: It is a major plus if you bring experience in ad-tech or programmatic advertising (aligning products with IAB specifications). Additionally, experience with NDK/JNI (C/C++ interop on Android) or parallel iOS development experience is highly valued to help support our cross-platform ecosystem.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will: 

  • Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
  • Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
  • Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention. 
  • Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
  • Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
  • Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
  • Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
  • Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
  • Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
  • Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Senior Asset Pipeline Engineer, Sim-Ready Content
description:
About Genesis AI

Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world.

About the Role

A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem.

We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out.

The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't.

Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. You'll be building that as a first-class part of the pipeline rather than bolting it on.

You'll work closely with the stakeholders, who set direction and priorities. You own the technical design and the implementation and you're expected to bring enough pipeline experience to challenge the plan where it needs challenging.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain the end-to-end asset pipeline, from ingestion through to validated output

  • Design agent-driven nodes that generate input content and make decisions inside the graph, with the structured outputs, guardrails and fallbacks that make them dependable in batch

  • Develop automated processing stages: mesh repair, retopology, decimation and LODs, UV unwrapping and texel density normalization, collision proxy generation

  • Derive physical properties so assets behave correctly in simulation: mass, inertia, contact parameters, articulation setup

  • Handle appearance: material conversion to PBR, texture processing, baking, and color management so assets render correctly in Nyx

  • Define and enforce asset standards (units, orientation, pivots, naming, provenance) and build the validators that reject noncompliant assets before they reach the library

  • Scale the pipeline to large batch runs, with caching, versioning and selective reprocessing when a stage changes

  • Build quality checks into the pipeline itself: physics stability harnesses, render smoke tests, automated evaluation of generated content, comparison on reprocessed assets

  • Work with the rendering, physics and research teams on what sim-ready needs to mean for each downstream use

What We're Looking For (ideally)

  • 5+ years building content or asset pipelines in games, VFX, simulation, or 3D tooling, with ownership of a pipeline in production

  • Deep knowledge of 3D asset formats and their quirks: USD, glTF, FBX, OBJ, plus physics description formats such as URDF or MJCF

  • Strong Python and C++ where processing needs to be fast

  • Hands-on mesh processing expertise: remeshing, decimation, UV generation, repair operations, convex decomposition, and a clear sense of how each one fails

  • Solid command of PBR material authoring, texture baking and color spaces

  • Experience driving DCC tools headlessly (Blender, Houdini, Maya) and building batch or distributed job systems around them

  • Practical experience putting LLM or agent calls into production systems: prompting, tool use, structured output, cost and latency control, and handling non-determinism

  • Understanding of what makes an asset physically valid in a simulator: visual versus collision geometry, mass properties, contact behavior, numerical stability

  • Judgment about quality bars, including when an asset is good enough and when it isn't

Nice to Have

  • Experience processing output from generative or reconstruction-based 3D sources, and evaluating that output automatically

  • Agent frameworks, orchestration and eval tooling applied to content generation

  • OpenUSD at scale: composition, layering, MaterialX

  • Semantic annotation and dataset curation at volume

  • Exposure to simulation stacks such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim or similar

description:
About Seamflow

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.

Where we are:

  • Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

  • $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

  • Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

The role

A Front End Design Engineer thinks in finished interfaces, not mockups or components in isolation. A technical reviewer at a notified body spends their day inside a 400-page technical file, cross-referencing clauses, checking test reports against standards, and deciding whether a medical device is safe to sell. Today they do that in Word, Acrobat and a spreadsheet someone built in 2011. The interface they use decides how fast they work and whether they trust the AI sitting next to them.

You own that interface. Layout, typography, interaction, motion, the design system underneath it, and the React that ships it. You decide how a reviewer sees a finding, how they correct a model that got it wrong, and how a hundred fields of dense regulatory data become something a person can actually read. You sketch it, build it, ship it, then sit next to someone using it and find out what you got wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

What we're looking for

We care far more about taste and engineering strength than about matching a list of tools. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in React, Svelte, Vue or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, craft and speed are not.

What we're actually screening for:

  • You've designed and built an interface that real people used every day. Not a Dribbble shot, not a component library nobody adopted. Something that shipped, got used, and got better.

  • You have taste, and you can defend it. Typography, spacing, motion, hierarchy. You notice when something is a few pixels off and you can explain why it matters.

  • You build the whole thing. Design, frontend, the state and data it sits on. You don't hand the code to someone else once the Figma is done, and you don't hand the design to someone else once the code is.

  • You can design for density. Expert users, complex workflows, hundreds of fields on a screen. Making that clear is much harder than making a landing page beautiful.

  • You go to the source. You'll watch a technical reviewer work through a real file, and you'll design for what they actually do rather than what the process diagram says.

Signals we like, none of them required:

design engineering or front-end roles at somewhere like Linear, Vercel, Notion or Figma, a design system you built and maintained, work on interfaces where people review or correct AI output, founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup.

This is probably not for you if

  • You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch.

  • You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning.

  • You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane.

What you get

  • Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar

  • Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room

  • Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly

  • Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster

  • A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics

If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV.

title: Senior GTM Manager
description:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

🚀 The Role

We’re hiring a Senior GTM Manager to join the Buy Engine.

tem predominantly sells through a partner network to SME businesses, and this role owns partner activation from systems to story. You’ll build the automation layer that makes the programme scalable, run the events and community engine that builds trust in market, drive the ABM plays that generate targeted pipeline, and translate tem’s product complexity into narratives partners and buy-side clients actually use. The metric you move is new pipeline generated.

The job requires two gears running in parallel. You ship fast, drawing on experience rather than waiting for a brief. And you zoom out regularly to build the systems that mean the next quarter is easier than this one.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Ship the agentic workflows that take the manual drag out of events, partner comms, and product marketing.

  • Build our events programme into a system that enables more in-person and community engagement across the UK and abroad.

  • Run ABM plays that generate new pipeline, with clear leading metrics helping you iterate quickly.

  • Turn tem’s most complex product and pricing innovation into positioning partners can sell.

  • Develop the automated product launch workflow, from PM spec through to go-to-market brief.

🛠️ Responsibilities

  • Build and automate: design and ship the agentic workflows that remove manual drag from events, partner comms, and product marketing, and keep building the GTM automation stack as the programme grows.

  • Run partner activation: own the events programme end to end, drive stickiness and engagement on our core activation channels, and run GTM experiments inside tem’s fortnightly sprint rhythm, compounding the playbook sprint by sprint.

  • Translate complexity into narrative: turn the hardest parts of energy into positioning partners can sell and customers are persuaded by, and keep the market story consistent and specific.

  • Own the intelligence loop: turn customer insights into structured signals that actively challenge and improve our positioning and GTM priorities, and own competitive intelligence on our key GTM bets.

  • Measure what matters: track what each activation play costs in time and money and what it returns in pipeline, own the reporting inside the fortnightly rhythm, and build the institutional memory that means the engine doesn’t reset when people join or leave.

✅ Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Builder orientation: you ship fast, draw on experience, and don’t need a fully formed brief to move.

  • Systems thinking in parallel: you can zoom out from daily execution to build the infrastructure that scales the programme, and do both at once.

  • Marketing literacy across the full GTM stack: positioning, narrative, activation, and channel strategy.

  • Hands-on, daily use of AI or no-code tools, with evidence you’ve built real workflows rather than one-off experiments.

  • B2B or B2B2C channel experience: you’ve marketed through or to a partner network, not just direct.

  • Comfortable operating at pace in a Series B environment where the playbook is being written as you go and the standards matter.

Desirable

  • Experience owning or contributing to an ABM programme.

  • Community or events programme ownership.

  • Exposure to complex or regulated industries where product narrative is genuinely hard, such as energy, fintech, infrastructure, or healthcare.

🎁 Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to £1,200 or €1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to £150 or €150 per month for wellbeing.

🤝 Interview Process

We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know.

  • First call with our Talent Team.

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager.

  • Technical Interview with the Team (90 mins). You’ll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss your approach to GTM systems design and partner activation.

  • Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

That sounds cool — what does a Customer Success Manager have to do with it?

Accurx works with 41 of the 42 NHS ICBs in primary care and is growing fast in secondary care. The relationships that make that possible — the trust, the renewals, the accounts that stay with us even when competitors come knocking on price — are owned by our Customer Success team.

We’re hiring three CSMs to grow the team across both primary and secondary care. You’ll own a portfolio of enterprise NHS accounts end-to-end, from implementation through to renewal. In primary care, it’s about protecting and deepening relationships that are already strong. In secondary care, it’s about building them from scratch in a market where Accurx Scribe is winning big and growing fast. Either way, it’s about being the person NHS organisations trust — the one who knows their priorities, anticipates problems before they arise, and makes Accurx genuinely indispensable.

The challenges you’ll solve as a Customer Success Manager

  • Own your NHS accounts end-to-end. You’ll manage a portfolio of 5–11 ICB or Trust enterprise accounts — building relationships, driving adoption, leading renewals, and keeping Accurx sticky even when the NHS is in flux. You’re the person your customers call first.

  • Build trust where Accurx is new. In secondary care, we’re expanding quickly into a more complex environment. You’ll help NHS Trusts get real outcomes from Accurx Scribe — building processes that don’t yet exist and earning the kind of trust we’ve spent years building in primary care.

  • Be a connector, not just an account manager. You’ll work across marketing, implementation, transformation, commercial ops, and finance. The best CSMs here don’t just manage accounts — they bring the voice of the customer back into the business and make things better for the whole team.

  • Build the playbook as you go. The team is scaling and many of our processes are still being written. You’ll contribute to and shape how account management works at Accurx. What works gets codified; what doesn’t gets challenged.

  • Navigate the NHS with patience and precision. NHS organisations are under enormous pressure — restructuring, funding uncertainty, stakeholder churn. You’ll hold relationships through difficult periods and keep Accurx front of mind even when it’s not their immediate priority.

You should apply if...

  • You own relationships, not just accounts. You’ve worked in customer success, account management, or a relationship-heavy role and you know the difference between being a yes-person and being a trusted advisor. Accurx has no commission plan — success here is measured by trust, retention, and real outcomes.

  • You push back constructively. You don’t jump when a customer says jump. You ask why — more than once — and you find a better solution. You’re empathetic but not a pushover.

  • You’re comfortable building from scratch. Processes aren’t fully defined here. You’d rather create structure than wait for someone else to do it, and you’re okay if the first version isn’t perfect.

  • You’re curious about the NHS. Whether you’ve worked in or around it or you’re coming in fresh — you’re genuinely interested in how it works and patient enough to navigate its complexity.

  • You’re AI-native. You use AI tools to work smarter — automating the routine so you can spend more time on the things that actually need you.

  • You’re a natural connector. You’re as comfortable in a room with a clinical lead as you are with a Trust’s Head of Digital Transformation or a commercial director. You adapt your style and bring people with you.

What’s in it for me?

You’ll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we’re led by our Principles and our mission to Solve Healthcare Productivity.

  • £50,000 – £70,000 salary + share options up to £15,000

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life
