title: Software Engineer (Future Hiring)
description:
About SugarAI UK Limited

SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI.

We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.

More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.

Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.

If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

Where You Fit In: 
SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality. 

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck. 

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

 

Disclaimer: When applying to this job posting, you are submitting your application for consideration of a role which may or may not actually exist, or be available now or in the future. Application submission is agreeing to be added to our Applicant Tracking System database, so we have the potential to surface your profile and reach out to you in the future, for opportunities which appear to be aligned to your background, experience or network.
 
To be considered for a specific job opening, please check out our Careers Page and apply to an active job posting. 

Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities): 

Agentic Development Systems 

  • Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves 

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review 

  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality 

  • Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly 

Feature Delivery 

  • Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments 

  • Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates 

  • Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers 

Code Quality & Review 

  • Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses 

  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code 

  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC 

Collaboration & Systems Thinking 

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing 

  • Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions 

  • Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned 

  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations 


What You Will Bring (Qualifications/Experience): 

  • 2–5 years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments 

  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment 

  • Hands-on experience with BDD/SDD frameworks and working from executable specifications as the primary input to development, this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job 

  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or modern SaaS language; comfort picking up new languages and frameworks as the work demands 

  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption 

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores 

  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end) 

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines 

  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team 


Preferred Qualifications/Experience: 

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures 

  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling 

  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product 

  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology 

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.

Beyond a stellar work environment, friendly people, and inspiring work, we have some sweet benefits and perks:
 
·       UK Pension Scheme

·       Health &Wellness Reimbursement Program
·       Unpaid sabbatical leave
·       Educational Resources - Career & Personal Development Program
·       Various discount programs (i.e. travel, virtual exercises classes, etc.)
·       We are a merit-based company with many opportunities to learn, excel and grow your career!

About the Role:

We are hiring a Senior Employment Counsel to be the first line of legal support for our People team.   • Identify and adopt AI tools that make legal support to the People team faster and more effective.

  • Track and reduce external counsel spend against a clear baseline.

What you bring:

  • Deep, current knowledge of DACH employment law (works councils, termination protections, co-determination), plus broad experience across other global jurisdictions.

  • A track record of advising HR and People teams directly, and translating legal risk into practical, business-pragmatic guidance.

  • Strong judgment and comfort making autonomous calls without escalating every matter to outside counsel.

  • Experience using AI tools to improve legal or compliance workflows.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to build trust across People, Legal, and Finance.

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

  • Strong interpersonal skills with prior experience in a client facing role

title: Doctorant : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control”
employer: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description:
Contexte :

ENSTA est un établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées. L’école a pour mission la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, dont les ingénieurs de l'armement et les ingénieurs des études et techniques de l'armement, ainsi que des cadres et docteurs hautement qualifiés pour les secteurs public et privé, en particulier dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et des technologies de pointe.

 

ENSTA accompagne par sa recherche, son innovation et son offre de formation la transformation des grands secteurs stratégiques nationaux répondant ainsi aux enjeux de souveraineté nationale. Elle dispose de 3 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR) organisées autour de 9 laboratoires de recherche (UER) qui mènent une recherche appliquée en relation étroite avec l’industrie.

 

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

 

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne.  Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

 

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

Sujet : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control”

Le poste fait partie du projet ERC-CdG « Preventing human-induced seismicity to fight climate change » (INJECT), financé par le Conseil européen de la recherche (ERC). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et à fort impact. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire.

Le changement climatique constitue une menace imminente pour notre civilisation. Les nouvelles technologies les plus en vue pour lutter contre le changement climatique font appel aux ressources énergétiques renouvelables et durables du sous-sol de la Terre et au stockage souterrain. Cependant, toutes ces technologies dépendent de l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre, ce qui peut provoquer d'importants tremblements de terre. INJECT résoudra ce problème en s'appuyant sur une nouvelle méthode scientifique révolutionnaire qui empêchera la sismicité induite par l'homme et maximisera la production et le stockage d'énergie à partir de ressources naturelles renouvelables et durables.

La méthodologie interdisciplinaire d'INJECT repose sur un programme scientifique astucieux qui place la théorie du contrôle et les mathématiques au cœur de ce nouveau défi. Sur la base de développements théoriques de pointe, des contrôleurs et des observateurs robustes seront conçus pour ajuster de manière optimale les taux d'injection de fluides, prévenir les événements sismiques induits sur de vastes régions et optimiser la production et le stockage d'énergie. Les méthodes théoriques innovantes d'INJECT seront testées en profondeur à l'aide de modèles numériques de haute fidélité qui tiendront compte de la dynamique poro-élasto, du frottement de Coulomb, de la multiphysique et de la modélisation d'ordre réduit. Le plan expérimental s'appuiera sur des démonstrateurs et des essais hybrides laboratoire-ordinateur pour tester la théorie. Pour plus d'informations : https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101087771 ----- class="Default" style="text-align:justify;">Missions / Activités principales :

Le thème de recherche se concentre sur le développement d'un dispositif innovant conçu pour reproduire et contrôler la sismicité induite dans un cadre de laboratoire.

 

En tant que chercheur doctorant, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conception et la construction de démonstrateurs innovants adaptés à la méthodologie d'INJECT. Cette opportunité englobe l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement, c'est-à-dire de la conceptualisation des idées à l'assemblage et au test rigoureux de prototypes de laboratoire avancés pour des expériences géomécaniques. Vous intégrerez la conception mécanique, l'ingénierie des matériaux, la mise en œuvre des capteurs et des contrôleurs, l'analyse des données et la modélisation numérique. L'objectif ultime est de reproduire et de contrôler les instabilités sismiques causées par des injections de fluides dans un environnement de laboratoire contrôlé, ouvrant ainsi la voie à des applications dans le monde réel.

Missions / Activité annexe :

·       Contribuer à toute activité du service en fonction des priorités retenues.

·       Contribuer à la démarche Qualité, notamment via la rédaction et la mise à jour des procédures, le renseignement et le suivi des indicateurs

·       Contribuer à la démarche RSE de l’Ecole dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités

Durée d’affectation souhaitée : CDD de 3 ans

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : dès que possible

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus Paris-Saclay, 828 boulevard des Maréchaux 91762 Palaiseau – Cedex

Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) mais également par les transports en commun

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 18 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  •        Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  •        Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  •        Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  •        Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  •        Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion, centre de loisirs pour les enfants du personnel à partir de 6 ans avec tarifs préférentiels (campus Paris-Saclay)

  •        Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

Candidature complète : curriculum vitae, lettre de motivation et coordonnées de 2 professeurs de référence


Les candidats retenus doivent posséder de solides compétences scientifiques et être très motivés. La maîtrise de l'anglais parlé et écrit est obligatoire.

Les candidats effectueront des recherches, développeront des dispositifs et des outils expérimentaux et rédigeront des articles scientifiques en étroite collaboration avec le PI du projet, Pr. Ioannis Stefanou, et les membres du groupe INJECT.

          

 Connaissances :

·       Une expérience dans le domaine des essais expérimentaux et de la conception (par exemple en géotechnique/géophysique/géomécanique) ou un diplôme de fin d'études dans ce domaine.

·       Intérêt pour la modélisation numérique, la conception mécanique et l'électronique.

·       Sens de l'organisation et rigueur.

·       Utilisation de logiciels de design industriel.

·       Compétences en Python.

·       Expérience en laboratoire et esprit d'équipe.

. Connaissances en physique/mathématiques/mécanique

Le Lab-STICC (Laboratoire des Sciences et Techniques de l'Information, de la Communication et de la Connaissance), est une unité mixte de recherche (UMR 6285) multi-tutelles (CNRS, IMT Atlantique, UBO, UBS, Bretagne INP, ENSTA)

Sujet :  

    De l'intention à l'implémentation : SpecIA, un langage de spécification agile pour l'ingénierie des systèmes embarqués

Contexte de la thèse :

Le sujet s'inscrit dans le cadre du projet DyNNamo financé par l’Agence Nationale le la Recherche (ANR). Il regroupe différentes équipes des deux grands laboratoires nationaux que sont l’IETR, l'IRISA et le LabSTICC.

Le projet DyNNamo vise à étudier et mettre en œuvre un nouveau type de réseaux de neurones, dits dynamiques, dans des dispositifs embarqués : le cas d’étude porte sur l’aide au handicap et plus précisément sur l’augmentation des capacités d’un fauteuil roulant pré-existant, organisé autour d’un systeme embarqué doté de différents capteurs, actionneurs et éléments de calcul. Ce type d’intelligence artificielle doit permettre à terme une meilleure prise en compte de situations de vie très variées dans le quotidien de la personne en situation de handicap.

 

 Problématique adressée : 

La conception de tels systèmes embarqués présente différentes problématiques technico-organisationnelles récurrentes : dans les phases amont de l’ingénierie, il est en particulier nécessaire de regrouper en un tout cohérent un ensemble d’informations initialement disparates ou incomplètes, et d’être en mesure, à tout instant, d’étudier les propriétés du système en devenir. Ces informations couvrent à la fois des aspects fonctionnels (présence de calculs dédiés), non-fonctionnels (comme la consommation électrique) ainsi que des scenario d’usage déterminants pour la pertinence du futur système à concevoir. Ces étapes de spécification amont doivent permettre de guider et consolider toutes les étapes aval de réalisation du produit final. En particulier, elles doivent servir de modèle de référence lors des différentes tâches de vérifications accompagnant le flot de conception. Ces préoccupations sont au cœur de l’Ingénierie Système, qui structure les projets d’envergure comme ceux envisagés historiquement dans le domaine des transports (avionique, ferroviaire), de l’énergie (nucléaire), etc. La pratique de l’Ingénierie Système et les technologies logicielles qui lui sont associées traditionnellement peinent toutefois à s’imposer à des échelles plus modestes et dans des équipes plus resserrées.

 

L’objectif principal de cette thèse est d’imaginer et de prototyper un nouveau langage de spécification facilitant la capture des intentions de l’ingénieur (description d’architecture et/ou du comportement attendu, etc.), puis d’en illustrer une exploitation simplifiée dans le cas d’étude couvert par le projet DyNNamo. Notons enfin que ce nouveau langage pourrait lui-même servir de passerelle vers des IA génératives (LLM : Large Language Model) ou tout autre forme d’apprentissage, orienté vers la conception des systèmes embarqués.

 

Missions principales :

  • Etude bibliographique : langages et techniques formelles pour la modélisation de systèmes embarqués.

  • Conception logicielle du langage (compilateur, interpréteur)

  • Mise à l’épreuve du langage sur le cas d’étude.

Equipe d'accueil :

La thèse se déroulera au sein du laboratoire LabSTICC (UMR CNRS, équipes ARCAD "architectures matérielles et outils de CAO") avec un co-encadrement à l'IETR (UMR CNRS). L'école doctorale est l'ED SPIN (Sciences pour l'ingénieur et le numérique).

Formation : Master recherche ou diplôme d’ingénieur (Bac+5) en Informatique (ou Electronique avec forte appétence en Informatique).

  • Langages et Compilation

  • Model-driven engineering

  • Qualités personnelles : autonomie, rigueur scientifique, esprit de synthèse.

Le projet AMRIT : 

Aujourd’hui, en Europe, l’exploitation des plateformes d’observation in situ s’appuie sur un réseau d’infrastructures de recherche réparties sur l’ensemble du continent. Les activités menées au sein de ce réseau comprennent des opérations in situ et à distance en mer, ainsi que la gestion des données issues d’un grand nombre de ressources pour une large gamme d’applications. Ces activités nécessitent d’importantes ressources informatiques, des efforts de R&D visant à améliorer les capacités des plateformes, ainsi que des activités de gestion et de financement pour assurer le fonctionnement des infrastructures et en garantir l’accès. AMRIT (Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together) est un projet pionnier conçu pour révolutionner le paysage des infrastructures de recherche marine (MRI) en Europe, en renforçant leur capacité à répondre aux enjeux politiques européens et aux défis scientifiques mondiaux.

AMRIT (https://www.amritproject.eu/) est un projet financé par Horizon Europe et l’UKRI, réunissant 26 partenaires européens, et destiné à faire progresser les MRIs au plan de leur coordination, en proposant la fédération de certains de leurs services informatiques. Il est coordonné scientifiquement par l’ENSTA. En développant des outils et des services pour la conduite des opérations des plateformes d’observation marine, AMRIT vise à :

  • Assurer un fonctionnement sans faille des plateformes d’observation marine.

  • Garantir la pleine utilisation nominale des capteurs et accélérer leur évolution.

  • Exploiter la complémentarité des différentes plateformes d’observation.

  • Assurer la cohérence globale de la chaîne de valeur des données océaniques.

  • Garantir une liste cohérente et exhaustive de métadonnées et de descripteurs.

 

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein du Campus de Brest.

Missions / Activités principales :

En tant que coordinateur scientifique du projet AMRIT dans le cadre d’Horizon Europe, l’ENSTA recherche un responsable scientifique et technique.

Les principales missions du responsable de projet sont les suivantes :

  • Coordonner la mise en œuvre globale du projet et en suivre l’avancement, notamment les lots de travail, les livrables, les jalons, les échéances et les indicateurs clés de performance, en étroite collaboration avec le coordinateur scientifique et avec le soutien du personnel administratif d’ARMINES ;

  • Suivre les risques liés au projet, les écarts et les actions correctives, et proposer des mesures d’atténuation ou d’ajustement si nécessaire ;

  • Diriger et coordonner le consortium, en maintenant une communication régulière avec ses membres, en facilitant la collaboration entre les partenaires, en assurant une circulation efficace de l’information et en accompagnant les partenaires dans la mise en œuvre de leurs activités ;

  • Organiser et coordonner les réunions du consortium, notamment les réunions du comité de pilotage, les réunions techniques et les assemblées générales, ainsi que leur préparation et leur suivi ;

  • Coordonner la préparation des rapports et des livrables du projet, en regroupant les contributions des partenaires et en garantissant leur qualité ainsi que leur remise dans les délais ;

  • Contribuer à la communication, à la diffusion et à l’exploitation des résultats du projet, notamment par le biais d’ateliers et de conférences, en coordination avec les partenaires concernés ;

  • Assurer la liaison principale avec la Commission européenne, notamment en maintenant.

Missions / Activité annexe :

  • Participer à la démarche Qualité de l’établissement ;

title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
description:
TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

 

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

 

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

 

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

 

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

 

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

 

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

About us

In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

HOW you will contribute to the company as a Senior Software Engineer?

As a Senior Software Engineer at Pennylane, your squad is your primary focus. You will contribute to building reliable, scalable and user-focused products, while helping the engineers around you grow and raising the quality of our technical execution. You will:

  • Understand and frame user and product problems, using your product knowledge to help your squad deliver simple, pragmatic and valuable solutions.

  • Lead significant technical deliveries within your squad, from understanding the problem to designing, implementing, testing and operating the solution in production.

  • Investigate and resolve complex production issues, using monitoring, observability and data analysis tools to identify root causes and prevent recurrence.

  • Design and evolve robust solutions, identifying performance, scalability and reliability opportunities and turning them into pragmatic technical improvements.

  • Bring strong expertise in at least one major part of our stack, while being able to join a new team and become autonomous on a high-impact initiative within a few weeks.

  • Improve engineering practices across the organization, through high-quality code reviews, pair programming, documentation, RFCs and the adoption of AI-assisted development without compromising software quality.

  • Act as a role model and a driver for other engineers, sharing knowledge, providing actionable feedback and helping the team continuously improve its technical skills and ways of working.

  • Collaborate effectively with other teams when needed, proactively unblocking technical topics and clearly communicating progress, risks, decisions and results to the relevant stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the Pennylane tech community, through technical content, onboarding, interviews, incident resolution, tech initiatives, meetups or other community-building activities.

 

🥇 You’re the right candidate if you…

  • Have strong hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails and React (at least 7-8 years)

  • Combine technical expertise with strong product and business understanding, enjoy solving complex problems and care deeply about your users.

  • Are a collaborative team player, communicate clearly and take ownership of delivering reliable, pragmatic solutions.

  • Like being challenged and solving complex problems (accounting is complex in Europe)

  • Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly

 
 

🎁 What we offer

description:

We are looking for an SEO & AI Content Specialist to work closely with our SEO Manager and the wider Growth team. Your mission will be to produce, improve and scale high-quality content that drives non-branded organic traffic and conversions, while embedding AI thoughtfully into the way we work.

This role is for someone who enjoys writing, structuring, optimising, measuring and iterating. You are curious about the evolution of search and eager to explore how people discover products through search engines and AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity.

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and enable accountants to focus on advising their clients.

A few figures that illustrate our scale and ambition:

💻 More than 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane.

🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 More than 1,100 Pennylaners work across the company, representing more than 25 nationalities.

💰 More than €400 million raised since launch.

🌍 A remote-friendly, international culture as we continue to grow across Europe.

What you’ll do

You will work closely with our SEO Manager and the wider Growth team and :

Build AI-powered content workflows

  • Use AI to accelerate research, outlining, first drafts and content optimisation, while maintaining a high editorial standard.

  • Help scale content production efficiently without compromising relevance, accuracy or clarity.

Produce and optimise high-value SEO content

  • Write, update and improve SEO content, including articles, pillar pages and landing pages, to generate non-branded organic traffic and conversions.

  • Build an understanding of the questions and prompts prospects use in AI-powered discovery tools.

  • Share learnings and contribute to shaping Pennylane’s evolving SEO and GEO playbook.

Make decisions with data

  • Monitor and prioritise work based on SEO performance signals, including visibility, rankings, impressions, clicks, CTR, organic traffic and conversions.

  • Translate data into concrete, actionable recommendations.

  • Run experiments, measure their impact and iterate quickly and rigorously.

What you bring

  • You have initial, meaningful hands-on experience in SEO, ideally with published content you can share.

  • You are fluent in French, with strong writing and editing skills. You also have professional working proficiency in English.

  • You enjoy improving content and are motivated by the challenge of turning a good page into a high-performing one.

  • You take a pragmatic, data-informed approach: you form hypotheses, test them, measure outcomes and improve.

  • You already use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow and are excited to deepen your practice.

  • You have a sharp eye for structure, clarity, accuracy and editorial quality.

  • You are comfortable working in a fast-moving, collaborative environment and know how to focus on the initiatives with the greatest business impact.

🛠️ Tools and environment

You will work with tools such as Meteoria, Profound, Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush, Contentful and Notion.

What you can expect

  • A role with real room to propose, structure and improve how SEO works at Pennylane.

  • The opportunity to develop expertise at the intersection of SEO, content, GEO and AI.

  • A demanding and supportive team that values execution, learning and sound judgement.

  • A direct and visible impact on organic acquisition and conversion.

  • A remote-friendly working environment, with access to home-office equipment, coworking options where relevant and regular opportunities to meet teammates in person.

  • Benefits that support flexibility, wellbeing, connection and growth. These may vary depending on your country, contract type and role.

📍 Location and working model

This role can be based in Paris on a hybrid basis, or remotely from anywhere in France.

🔎 Our recruitment process

All interviews are held remotely:

  1. An initial conversation with Talent Acquisition (30 min).

  2. A conversation with the Hiring Manager (30 min).

  3. A case study and debrief with the Hiring Manager and a team member (1 hour).

  4. A final team-fit conversation with a Marketing Team Lead (30 min).

🌈 Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Pennylane is committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment, with equal opportunities for all candidates regardless of social or ethnic background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability or any other personal characteristic.

We know that some people are less likely to apply when they do not meet every single requirement. If this role sounds exciting and you believe you could make an impact, we would love to hear from you.

⚠️ Important information for candidates

Please apply only through Pennylane’s official channels. Our communications are sent from email addresses ending in @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com.

We will never ask you to make a payment or share financial information during the recruitment process.

title: Head of People Partnering & Development
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1300 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Accompagne la croissance de Pennylane en faisant travailler ensemble les HRBPs et le People Development

Pennylane est une scale-up fintech de 1 200 collaborateurs, présente en France, en Allemagne et en Espagne. Dans un contexte de forte croissance, d’expansion européenne et de transformation des métiers par l’IA, nous recrutons notre futur·e Head of People Partnering & Development.

Rattaché·e à la VP People, tu travailleras au plus près du COMEX et des leaders de l’entreprise.

Ta mission

Ta mission sera d’accompagner la croissance de Pennylane en faisant travailler ensemble deux disciplines complémentaires :

  • les HRBPs, qui accompagnent les équipes, les managers et les organisations au plus près des enjeux business ;

  • le People Development, qui porte le développement des compétences, la performance, les career paths, la gestion des talents et les programmes managers.

Tu veilleras à connecter ces expertises afin de proposer une approche People cohérente, internationale et directement alignée avec les priorités business.

Tes principales responsabilités

Stratégie People et accompagnement du business

  • Construire et piloter la roadmap commune HRBP et People Development ;

  • accompagner les enjeux organisationnels liés à la croissance et à l’internationalisation ;

  • conseiller et challenger les leaders sur leurs enjeux d’organisation, de management et de talents ;

  • développer une approche People fondée sur la donnée et l’anticipation ;

  • suivre les indicateurs clés : turnover, engagement, performance, capacité organisationnelle et développement des compétences.

Coordination internationale

  • Garantir une approche cohérente entre la France, l’Allemagne et l’Espagne ;

  • coordonner les sujets cross-country : mobilité, career paths, performance et pratiques managériales ;

  • trouver le bon équilibre entre harmonisation internationale et spécificités locales ;

  • contribuer à la construction d’une culture commune.

Management et collaboration des équipes

  • Manager et développer une équipe d’environ 11 personnes sur les pôles HRBP et People Development ;

  • créer les conditions d’une collaboration efficace entre les deux disciplines ;

  • clarifier les rôles, les responsabilités et les modes de fonctionnement ;

  • renforcer la posture stratégique et l’influence de l’équipe auprès des leaders ;

  • développer les compétences de l’équipe sur la data, le change et l’IA.

Talents, performance et développement

  • Piloter la stratégie Learning & Development ;

  • structurer les cycles de performance et les calibrations ;

  • développer les career paths, le job grading et le levelling ;

  • piloter les talent reviews et le succession planning ;

  • développer les programmes managers ;

  • accompagner les initiatives liées à l’engagement, à la culture et à la reconnaissance.

IA et transformation des métiers

  • Anticiper l’impact de l’IA sur les métiers, les compétences et les organisations ;

  • identifier les cas d’usage pertinents pour la fonction People ;

  • accompagner les équipes et les managers dans l’adoption de nouveaux outils ;

  • intégrer l’IA dans les pratiques HRBP et People Development de manière utile et responsable.

Le profil recherché

Tu as 8 à 12 ans d’expérience en RH, dont au moins 3 à 4 ans dans un rôle de leadership, par exemple :

  • DRH ou Head of People dans une entreprise tech de 200 à 600 collaborateurs ;

  • Head of HRBP dans une scale-up ou une entreprise en forte croissance ;

  • Head of HRBP dans un grand groupe

Tu as déjà structuré une fonction RH ou HRBP, recruté et développé une équipe, travaillé avec des dirigeants et accompagné une organisation en croissance. Une expérience internationale et une première pratique de l’IA dans un contexte RH seront particulièrement appréciées.

Ce qui fera la différence

Tu combines :

  • une forte compréhension des enjeux business et organisationnels ;

  • une capacité à influencer et challenger les leaders ;

  • un vrai talent pour faire travailler ensemble des expertises différentes ;

  • une approche structurée, data-driven et orientée résultats ;

  • de la curiosité pour l’IA et les nouvelles technologies ;

  • du courage managérial, de l’humilité et le goût du collectif.

Les dimensions du poste

  • Périmètre : 1 100 collaborateurs ;

  • Pays : France, Allemagne et Espagne ;

  • Équipe : environ 11 personnes ;

  • Rattachement : VP People ;

  • Interlocuteurs clés : COMEX, Directors, Heads of, Talent Acquisition, People Operations, Legal et Compensation.

Processus de recrutement

- 1ère échange avec Nathalie, Talent Acquisition - 45min

Nous tenons également à souligner que nous adhérons pleinement aux principes de diversité, d’équité et d’inclusion, et que nous mettons tout en œuvre pour créer un environnement sûr et inclusif.
Nous nous engageons à offrir l’égalité des chances en matière d’emploi, sans distinction de genre, d’orientation sexuelle, d’origine, de handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique qui fait de vous ce que vous êtes. Au contraire, la diversité rend notre lieu de travail encore plus agréable.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins enclines à postuler que d’autres si elles ont l’impression de ne pas répondre à l’ensemble des critères.

 

Si vous hésitez, nous vous encourageons à postuler : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d’une collaboration enrichissante et durable.

💵 Vous bénéficierez d’une rémunération compétitive

Nous travaillons à étendre ces derniers avantages à nos collaborateurs basés hors de France, mais cela peut s’avérer plus complexe selon les pays.

title: Product Manager (Protocol)
description:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

 

Role

Morpho's Protocol team is evolving the core lending infrastructure that powers products and markets across the ecosystem. As the number of opportunities, integrations, and protocol initiatives grows, the team needs clear product direction on what to build, why it matters, and how to sequence the work.

This role will work with Morpho’s protocol team to shape product strategy and guide execution. You will turn the needs of users and ecosystem partners into a focused roadmap, work closely with protocol and engineering teams to shape solutions, and drive improvements from discovery through launch and adoption. You will operate at the intersection of deeply technical systems, financial markets, and a fast-moving ecosystem.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own the roadmap for Morpho's protocol team, defining the highest-impact problems to solve and sequencing opportunities against company goals, user needs, technical constraints, and ecosystem dynamics.

  • Build and run a continuous discovery process with curators, distributors, integrators, developers, and other protocol users to understand their workflows, pain points, and emerging needs.

  • Translate user and market insights into clear product requirements, decision frameworks, and success criteria that help protocol and engineering teams move quickly with strong rationale.

  • Partner closely with protocol, engineering, research, security, legal, solutions, partnerships, and marketing to take initiatives from early exploration through design, implementation, audit, launch, and adoption.

  • Evaluate product and technical tradeoffs, including when to extend the protocol, improve surrounding infrastructure, enable partners, or deliberately avoid adding complexity.

  • Define and track the signals that show whether protocol initiatives are working, combining quantitative data with ecosystem feedback to guide iteration and future investment.

  • Communicate product direction, decisions, tradeoffs, and release implications clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Improve how product decisions are made and documented as Morpho and its protocol ecosystem scale.

 

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

You understand Morpho's protocol, development and release process, current roadmap, and the rationale behind the major initiatives in flight. You have built relationships across protocol, engineering, research, security, and go-to-market teams, and have started speaking with key curators, distributors, integrators, and developers.

 

First 3 months

You have established a clear, prioritized view of the most important protocol problems and opportunities. The roadmap reflects explicit tradeoffs, user evidence, technical constraints, and measurable outcomes. You have driven at least one meaningful initiative from discovery into execution and proactively keep stakeholders aligned on decisions and changes.

 

First 6 months

You have shipped a meaningful protocol improvement and can show how it advanced user or business outcomes. Product, protocol, and engineering teams have stronger shared context on what to build and why. You consistently identify important user needs, ecosystem shifts, and roadmap conflicts early, and have improved Morpho's product discovery and decision-making process.

 

Must Have Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years building technical products in complex or fast-changing environments.

  • Proven track record taking products or major features from ambiguous problem spaces through launch and iteration.

  • Strong technical fluency, with the ability to reason about system design and constraints, engage deeply with engineers and researchers, and translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

  • Excellent product judgment: you can distinguish important user problems from requests, make principled tradeoffs, and focus teams on the work with the greatest impact.

  • Strong user discovery and synthesis skills, with the ability to uncover needs across different user types and turn incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear direction.

  • Experience leading cross-functional work without relying on formal authority.

  • Ability to define success, use quantitative and qualitative evidence, and adapt direction as new information emerges.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, especially in an async environment.

  • Comfort creating clarity and driving decisions in highly ambiguous contexts.

  • Strong ownership and autonomy: you act without waiting to be told.

  • Team-first mindset, low ego.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience in crypto, DeFi, traditional finance, or fintech.

  • Familiarity with lending markets, smart contracts, or permissionless protocols.

  • Experience shipping products with significant security, audit, regulatory, or governance considerations.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

description:

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Context

We're experiencing one of the strongest growth rates in the French Tech ecosystem: we're targeting €10M ARR by the end of 2026. To achieve this, we need to triple the sales team while increasing productivity, and therefore the ARR signed per account executive.

Your mission

At the end of your first year, you will have built a system in which our SDRs spend zero time on bad leads and 100% of their time on high-intent, well-qualified, properly enriched prospects.

You own the GTM infrastructure end-to-end. You sit at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, and Data. You report to the Head of RevOps, your main "client" is the Sales team.

This is an A to Z hands-on role. You define the strategy, build the workflows, run them, iterate.

 

Responsibilities

Pipeline Generation & Qualification

  • Design and maintain automated lead sourcing workflows (Clay, Apollo, Pharow, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)

  • Build enrichment pipelines: firmographics, intent signals, tech stack, hiring activity

  • Define ICP scoring models and qualification criteria

  • Reduce SDR time spent on prospecting, give them lists they can act on immediately

GTM Tooling & Automation

  • Own the outbound stack: sequencing tools, enrichment tools, data providers

  • Build and maintain integrations between tools (CRM, enrichment, outreach, tracking)

  • Automate manual tasks: list building, data deduplication, routing, assignment

  • Ensure data flows cleanly from source → CRM (Attio)

CRM & Data Hygiene

  • Keep the pipeline clean: right stages, right fields, right owners

  • Instrument touchpoints (emails, calls, LinkedIn, demos) in the CRM

  • Monitor data completeness; kill dead weight in the funnel

GTM Analytics

  • Build dashboards on pipeline quality (source, stage conversion, cycle length)

  • Identify funnel leaks and fix them

  • Not a pure ops role, you build things that run without you

  • Not a data analyst role, dashboards serve decisions, not decoration

1 month

  • Map the SDR workflow end-to-end: where is time wasted, where does quality drop

  • First enrichment pipeline running in production

3 months

  • Fully automated ICP-qualified lead lists delivered to SDRs weekly

  • Enrichment coverage >80% on key signals (industry, headcount, tech stack, intent)

  • Outbound stack rationalized and documented

  • Pipeline dashboards live and trusted

6–12 months

  • GTM infrastructure that scales without adding headcount

  • SDRs spending <20% of time on list building / data ops

  • Measurable improvement in SQL rate and pipeline coverage

  • Company ready to scale outbound x3 with the same tooling

This role is for you if

  • 2–6 years in RevOps, Sales Ops, BizOps, Growth Ops in a SaaS / startup that scaled

  • Very strong with tools and wants to build from the ground up (CRM, spreadsheets, automation)

  • Structured thinker, you prioritize your task according to the impact on your yearly mission : scale sales and attain 10M in ARR.

  • You're structured, pragmatic, and execution-driven

  • You're comfortable working directly with founders

  • You care about data, but even more about things actually working

Benefits

  • Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8–12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays).

  • Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3-4 days at the office, 1-2 day per week remote.

  • MacBook provided.

  • EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib).

Recruitment process

2️⃣ Hiring Manager interview (45 min) with Robin, Head of Revops

3️⃣ Case study (1hr) with Alexandre, and Robin

4️⃣ Reference check

5️⃣ Offer ! 🎉

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

title: Automated Testing Module Lead
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Automated Testing Module Lead, you take ownership of how Harmattan validates its autonomy and flight-software stack. Today, our software is validated mostly against real hardware, a process that consumes airframes, range time, and crew while sampling only a handful of nominal trajectories. The cases we actually build for, such as degraded GNSS, sensor dropout, electronic warfare, and multi-agent situations, are rarely reached economically that way. Your mission is to establish the scenario library, execution strategy, and interface bricks to turn our existing simulation platform into a fast, reliable, and continuous validation engine.

This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role. You inherit an active team of four engineers across Paris and Lausanne, with a target of around eight by mid-2027. Beyond leading the team, you become the technical authority on our scenario-based testing: defining what runs across SITL, HITL, and CI, holding critical technical boundaries with adjacent teams, and bridging the gap between simulation fidelity and real flight data.

What You Will Do

  • Team Leadership & Strategy: Take over, structure, and give a clear mandate to our existing team of four engineers, while building the case and the roadmap to scale the module to around eight by mid-2027.
    Scenario & Simulation Engineering: Drive the design of a versioned scenario library covering nominal, edge, off-nominal, and contested flight conditions, expanding into Monte Carlo and multi-agent testing, and bring a team with no prior simulation experience up that curve.

  • Execution Strategy & Gating: Establish what tests run across SITL, HITL, and CI, defining gating policies, telemetry capture, deterministic replay, and coverage analytics.

  • Interface & Boundary Ownership: Negotiate, then maintain, strong, written technical boundaries with Tooling (who provide the simulation platform) and co-ownership splits with Validation (who define acceptance criteria and own final sign-off).

  • Sim-to-Real Correlation: Correlate simulation models against real flight data to continuously measure and close the sim-to-real gap, ensuring green test gates reflect real-world flight readiness.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years in automated testing, simulation-based validation, or test engineering for complex physical / hardware-in-the-loop systems (e.g., Autonomous Driving, Aerospace, Defense, Robotics).
    Scenario & Simulation Depth: Hands-on experience designing scenario-based test suites on a simulation platform and defining coverage that genuinely catches defects. This is the capability our current team lacks, and therefore the most valuable thing you can bring.

  • Technical Depth: Hands-on proficiency in Python, C++, Linux, Docker, and CI environments, with deep domain expertise in scenario design, SITL/HITL execution, and simulation tools.

  • Leadership & Ownership: Proven ability to step into an existing engineering team, establish immediate clarity, and manage distributed engineers (Paris and Lausanne) effectively**, including engineers more senior than you in years of experience**.

  • Validation Mindset: A rigorous, analytical approach to noisy physical metrics, false positives, and flaky test environments, instinctively questioning what a passing test proves.

  • Cross-Functional Diplomacy: Track record of defining and holding clear interfaces with platform providers and internal customer teams.
    Bonus: Background in defense/aerospace flight software, control systems, or experience closing sim-to-real fidelity gaps.

  • Location & Travel: Based in Paris or Lausanne, with travel between sites. Working-
    level English.

What We Offer

  • Immediate Impact: Take over an established mandate with an existing team and pre-built simulation platform, delivering test capability in weeks rather than building from scratch.

  • High System Scope: Own the entire scenario library and execution strategy across our autonomy stack.
    Direct Mission Impact: Build test pipelines that directly accelerate the deployment of resilient autonomous systems in real-world defense environments.
    Cross-Functional Ownership: Work closely with Tooling, Validation, GNC, Perception, and Embedded SW teams to shape the future of flight-software reliability.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

At Bigblue, we're building the logistics backbone for the next generation of commerce.

Modern brands sell everywhere: through their own online stores, marketplaces, retail, social commerce, and more. Across every channel, customers expect the same fast, reliable, and transparent experience after they buy. What used to be Amazon's exclusive advantage is now becoming the standard for every ambitious brand. We're helping them get there.

Since 2018, we've built a tech-driven fulfilment platform used by 600+ brands, including Muji, Aigle, Scuffers, and Cabaïa. With 200+ Bigbluers across the UK, France, Spain, and Germany, our proprietary tech stack, and a network of 9 warehouses and over 100,000 sqm of fulfilment space across Europe, we ship millions of orders every month. And we're nowhere near done!

Backed by €20M+ in funding, we're expanding across Europe and building the operating system that will power modern commerce operations at a global scale.

At Bigblue, we hold ourselves to a very high bar: in the quality of our product, the rigour of our operations, and the care we bring to every merchant we work with. You'll be working alongside talented people on real, high-impact problems, in an environment where high standards come with genuine support, ownership, and room to grow. If you want your work to matter from day one, you're in the right place.

 
 

About the Role

As Head of AI Enablement, you will help Bigblue become the most productive commerce operations company in Europe through AI. Your job is not just to raise AI usage across the business — it is to instill an AI-first mindset, so that every team develops a muscle for reaching for new AI capabilities instinctively, and is enabled to act on those instincts.

This role sits at the intersection of internal transformation and external impact. The AI systems and workflows you build internally are increasingly becoming part of Bigblue's external story — shaping how we serve merchants, how our agents engage with them in-product, and how we turn our own operational learnings into time and money saved for the 600+ brands we serve.

You will work across disciplines as part builder, part data expert, part product manager, and part business-ops maven, co-developing the cutting edge of AI tooling for the Bigblue team and using it to drive massive change at high velocity. You will start hands-on, shipping the first high-impact automations yourself, then scale a team of AI engineers to multiply your impact across every function.


What you'll do
  • Make sure Bigblue teams can deploy AI tools and workflows at the fastest rate in the industry — through enablement and through the development of internal AI products, agents, skills, and tools.
  • Get non-engineering teams (Account management, Sales, Finance, Transportation, Logistics) leveraging our internal AI stack through focused enablement, product improvements, and individual success stories — surfacing context from our stack, automating merchant-issue triage, billing exceptions, and reporting.
  • Measure the impact of internal products via (AI-built!) dashboards and QA checks, and iterate based on real user feedback.
  • Seed an AI-native culture: coach internal "AI champions" and embed templates and practices into team norms.
  • Build feedback loops that make internal agent performance compound over time — making teams faster and higher-quality at their work, while evolving the external-facing systems that sharpen how Bigblue engages with merchants through AI.
  • Tackle foundational AI infrastructure with our technical teams: data reliability, managing shared AI skills at scale, and the hard operational problems underneath a truly AI-powered company.
  • Help package and tell Bigblue's internal AI journey externally — through merchant pitches, conferences, and content — as we productize what we've built for our customers.

    • What You Need
  • 4-8+ years in product management, product ops, BizOps, strategy, technical program management, engineering, or similar — with deep, demonstrated experience using AI to build, ship, and transform work.
  • Technical fluency with development copilots and low-code/no-code tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Notion), SQL and BI tools, APIs, scripting, and integrations.
  • LLM integration depth: tool use, structured outputs, prompt engineering, fallback handling, and cost controls with OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent.
  • Operational empathy: you partner with business teams to deeply understand their challenges and ship rapid solutions.
  • Strong communicator: you write crisp docs (with AI!) and run persuasive internal training sessions that have lasting impact.
  • Comfort being steeped in operational and usage data — you decide based on what's actually happening, not just what teams report.
  • Self-starter with high agency, comfortable with autonomy and ambiguity. Production discipline: fast iteration without fragile systems.

    • Nice-to-Haves
  • Familiarity with departmental workflows in operating teams.
  • Prior experience in internal enablement or change-management programs.
  • Curiosity about external applications of internal AI work: customer-facing agents, or commercializing operational learnings.
  • Familiarity with logistics, supply chain, or operations-heavy B2B environments.
  • French language skills (our team operates across France, Spain, the UK, and Germany).

    • Not for You if
  • You prefer strategy briefings over hands-on delivery.
  • You lean toward AI research rather than applied AI work.
  • You'd rather manage people than building solutions and finding new edges through technology.
  • You're not interested in the sometimes unglamorous work of making AI systems reliable and scalable.

    • What success looks like

    In your first 30 days, you have embedded with at least one internal team, mapped a workflow end-to-end, and shipped something real into production.

    By 90 days, you have measurably reduced manual work that was previously just accepted as the cost of doing business, and people in that team can point to it.

    By six months, internal teams are coming to you with problems before they even think to file a ticket; you have a library of reusable patterns that others are building on, and you and the team you have hired set the standard for how AI-powered internal tooling gets built at Bigblue.

    Why join Bigblue
     
    💼 High impact role: Be at the center of our growth journey and help shape the team that will power Bigblue’s future.
    💙 Founders-led company with an innovative, caring culture.
    🚀 Fast-growing scale-up: Join a well-funded, early-stage company where your work will have immediate and visible results.
    🌍 International environment: Work across Paris, Madrid, London, and our European warehouse network.
    🏢 Brand-new offices in the heart of Paris’ 9th arrondissement (biggest tech hub).
    🍱 10€ meal voucher per worked day (55% paid by Bigblue) + unlimited free snacks at the office.
    🧘‍♀️ ClassPass membership for fitness & wellness.
    🖥️ MacBook or any setup you need — your choice of equipment to do your best work.
    🩺 100% health insurance coverage with Benefiz.
     
     
    Regardless of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, origin, disability, age… At Bigblue, we create equal opportunities for all and make our culture as inclusive as possible. Because we believe that challenging assumptions and embracing diversity in experiences and backgrounds is what makes us stronger.
    Because what we value first and foremost are curiosity and growth-driven minds. So, regardless of who you are and how many “boxes” you tick on the job description, if you have the energy and passion to help shape Bigblue’s entrepreneurial adventure, APPLY.

title: Customer Success Specialist 🇫🇷
description:
E-commerce is booming — but independent brands still struggle to match the seamless logistics of giants like Amazon. At Bigblue, we’re on a mission to change that.

We help brands by democratizing best-in-class operations: scaling faster while delivering a five-star customer experience.

Since 2018, we’ve built a tech-driven logistics platform powering 600+ brands — from fast-growing DTC players to global names like MUJI, Aigle, and Cabaïa. With 220+ employees across Paris, Madrid, and London, our proprietary WMS (Warehouse Management System) Atlas, and a network of 9 warehouses across Europe, we’re solving logistics challenges that others haven’t dared to tackle — making fulfillment faster, smarter, and greener.

Backed by $20+M in funding and trusted by the next generation of e-commerce leaders, we’re scaling rapidly — from 10 million orders in 2024 toward ambitious enterprise expansion.

The journey ahead is bold, and we’re looking for the right partner to help us lead the way.


🚀 About The Role
The Customer Success Specialist will be responsible for retaining and building Bigblue small to medium accounts by increasing their overall satisfaction, helping those accounts to grow & upsell, and eradicating churn.
Location: Paris 9th, France (Hybrid)
As Customer Success Specialist, you will:

Own the success of a portfolio of small to medium merchants

  • Provide strong support when complex cases cannot be handled in a written way (level 2 of escalation)
  • Serve as the main point of contact for a defined merchant portfolio, managing the relationship end-to-end with limited supervision
  • Monitor account health metrics proactively to detect risks before they escalate
  • Handle escalations autonomously — from identification to resolution — with a clear sense of ownership

    • Retain and grow merchant revenue

  • Identify and act on upsell and expansion opportunities within your business unit
  • Spot high-potential merchants and actively support their growth into higher tiers
  • Build lasting relationships that reduce churn and increase merchant satisfaction

    • Continuously improve merchant experience

  • Build pro-activate communications to help our merchant improving their experience with Bigblue
  • Identify recurring pain points across your accounts and propose scalable solutions (templates, processes, playbooks)
  • Contribute to team rituals and knowledge-sharing — webinars, best practice guides, internal documentation
  • Flag patterns in merchant feedback that can inform product or ops improvements

    • 💼 You would be a great fit if this sounds like you:
  • 2+ years of experience managing customer relationships in Customer Success, Account Management, client operations, or another role where you owned customer outcomes—not only handled individual requests.
  • Experience independently managing a portfolio of customers, balancing competing priorities while maintaining reliable follow-up.
  • Proven ability to handle complex or sensitive customer escalations, investigate root causes, coordinate with internal teams, and communicate a clear resolution plan.
  • Strong prioritization and ownership: you can assess urgency and business impact, decide what requires immediate attention, and drive issues through to resolution.
  • Data-informed approach to customer management: you can use customer, operational, or performance indicators to identify risks and determine the right next action.
  • Commercial awareness: you can recognize retention risks and growth opportunities while recommending solutions that create value for both the customer and Bigblue.
  • Clear and adaptable communication: you can explain operationally complex topics, set expectations, and deliver difficult messages constructively.
  • Comfort working in a complex, fast-changing environment, with the ability to quickly learn new operational processes, tools, and products.
  • Full professional proficiency in French and English, both written and spoken.

    • 🥇 Bonus points for
     
    Nice to haves:
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure
  • Prior experience in logistics, fulfilment or related fields 
  • Be autonomous to solve issues with merchants
  • Have an optimistic point of view: “there are no problems, only solutions”
  • Experience in a scale-up
  • Other language skills ( 🇪🇸, 🇩🇪, 🇮🇹)
